band_recipe_actual.note: Speeds are the last F before each extruding move; fan values are the last M106 S (0-255, 102 = 40 %, 229 = 90 %); lengths are extruded XY path lengths (arc chords). Fan follows the filament profile, not the band: only overhang-wall and bridge paths get the 90 % overhang/bridge fan.

arm_bonding.method: Radial exported-mesh sections every degree at the band centre; bonded where the section exceeds the R7 wall profile by more than 0.15 mm.

lead_in_skirt.method: Native ray sections of the exported assembly STL through the skirt on 4 angles per 1 mm layer step, at least 1 mm inside the sloped leading edge, with actual bead-centre clusters on each ray.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Key presses and rod loads pass from the slab into both rings through this neck.
Key_Carrier.decision: A 3 mm wide neck flaring at 45 degrees into a 7.6 mm tombstone saddle; the rear ring is on the bed.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Press every key while the carrier is on a rod; inspect the saddle for splits.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Key_Carrier.feature: Inter-row strip section at Y 8.9 (whole upper-row-to-lower-row interlayer load path)
Key_Carrier.note: Interlayer load path: the whole section in this layer plane and the conservative inscribed bead footprints that actually printed. Not a breaking force.
Interlayer load path: the whole section in this layer plane and the conservative inscribed bead footprints that actually printed. Not a breaking force.

Key_Carrier.feature: Plate lip over the clip relief
Key_Carrier.load_case: Switch clips snap under this 0.75 mm lip; pulling a switch loads it.
Key_Carrier.decision: Standard 1.2 mm plate thickness; the lip is backed by the solid wall behind the relief.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Insert and remove a switch twice; inspect the lip for cracks.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Key_Carrier.load_case: The outer lower keys are pushed sideways against this wall by sideways cap play.
Key_Carrier.decision: A 1.2 mm wall outside the clip relief, continuous into the plate and backplate.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Press the outer keys with sideways bias.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Key_Carrier.load_case: The switch housing bears on this plate; the socket pads stay 1.6 mm.
Key_Carrier.decision: Backplate 1.2 mm away from the socket zone, 1.6 mm under the socket bosses.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Push a switch home and remove it; look for backplate cracks at the holes.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Key_Carrier.feature: Right shoulder section at Y 12.0 (outer lower bay hangs from the upper slab here)
Key_Carrier.note: Interlayer load path: the whole section in this layer plane and the conservative inscribed bead footprints that actually printed. Not a breaking force.
Interlayer load path: the whole section in this layer plane and the conservative inscribed bead footprints that actually printed. Not a breaking force.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Cell weight and handling load the chords and zigzag struts.
Battery_Holder.decision: 1.6 mm chords joined by 45-degree struts; the far end plate sits on the bed.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Flex the cage gently by hand after printing.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Every floor chevron lands on the spine and the spine carries both rings.
Battery_Holder.decision: 1.8 mm spine widening to 7.6 mm saddles at both rings.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Load the cell and slide the module on the rod; inspect the spine.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_Holder.feature: Gate guide slot wall beside the gate (outside the slot Y range)
Battery_Holder.load_case: The gate bears in Y against these guide faces; as in R15 the slot is open toward the cage so the bar can pass, and only the outer wall takes the wedge interference.
Battery_Holder.decision: Guide block 2.25 mm thick each side of the 2.1 mm slot in Y, led in at 45 degrees from the side rail.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Fit the gate gently; stop if the guide whitens.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Wedge interference loads the outer wall across its layers.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Fit and remove the gate three times.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_Holder.load_case: The cell rests on the chevron bars.
Battery_Holder.decision: 1.6 mm bars at 45 degrees to the bed and to the side rails.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Inspect the bars under the loaded cell.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_End_Gate.load_case: Gate insertion and removal flex the wedge necks.
Battery_End_Gate.decision: R15 wedge profile retained; the gate prints flat.
Battery_End_Gate.required_physical_test: Cycle the gate without a cell first.
Battery_End_Gate.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_End_Gate.load_case: The bar is pulled to remove the gate.
Battery_End_Gate.decision: 1.9 mm deep bar above the cell, with two stubs at the cell end corners.
Battery_End_Gate.required_physical_test: Pull the gate out by its bar only.
Battery_End_Gate.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Battery_End_Gate.load_case: The stubs stop the cell at its end corners away from the lead end.
Battery_End_Gate.decision: 2.5 mm wide stubs, 1.6 mm thick, open centre for the leads.
Battery_End_Gate.required_physical_test: Check the leads pass between the stubs without being pinched.
Battery_End_Gate.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Board insertion, USB plugging and lead snags load the rails.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 2.0 x 2.8 mm rails running end to end, bonded to both ring planes.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Insert the board and plug USB; check the rails.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The keel joins both crowns and backs the near ring saddle.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 3 mm keel from end to end.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Slide the holder onto the rod; inspect the keel.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Board loads pass from the rails through the bars into the ring crowns.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 2.2 mm flat bars in the ring planes; the far pair prints on the bed, the near pair bridges 6 mm onto the saddle.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Press the board down gently; inspect the bar roots.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Board ledge root into the rail
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The board edges rest on the ledges; the ledge gusset roots into the rail.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 45-degree gussets from the rails at the header-free short ends, measured through the gusset into the rail.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Seat the board and press on it lightly.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis for every R16 part.

Key_Carrier.feature: Slab-to-ring saddle and crown, full length
Key_Carrier.load_case: Every key press and rod load passes through this saddle into the two rings.
Key_Carrier.decision: Saddle neck 3 mm at the slab flaring to a 7.6 mm tombstone; the scan covers every layer from the mid ring to the bed.
Key_Carrier.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

Key_Carrier.feature: Inter-row strip, every layer between the lower reliefs (Y 7.15) and the upper reliefs (Y 10.65)
Key_Carrier.load_case: The upper row hangs from this strip.
Key_Carrier.decision: Solid strip 3.5 mm thick over the full upper-slab width.
Key_Carrier.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

Key_Carrier.feature: Right shoulder root region, every layer (Y 9.1-16.5; the 45-degree taper narrows to a point at Y 18.45 against the upper slab wall by design)
Key_Carrier.load_case: The lower-right bay hangs from the upper slab through this shoulder while printing and in use.
Key_Carrier.decision: Solid 45-degree shoulder, 3.85 mm thick, at least 1.9 mm wide over the scanned span.
Key_Carrier.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

Key_Carrier.feature: Left shoulder root region, every layer (Y 9.1-16.5)
Key_Carrier.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

Key_Carrier.feature: Lower row, every layer through the bays
Key_Carrier.load_case: Lower key presses and the finger load the lower row around its five openings and the backplate ligaments.
Key_Carrier.decision: Bay walls, lips and the thinned backplate; ligaments beside the windows are 1.2 mm.
Key_Carrier.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Rails, keel, struts and saddle between the ring planes, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The board and USB loads pass along the rails into both ring planes; this is the former 21 mm free-column region.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Two 2 x 2.8 mm rails, a 3 mm keel, a 7.6 mm saddle and two diagonal struts tie the columns mid-height.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Near +X ledge, top 0.45 mm under the board plane, every layer under the board
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The board corner rests here; USB plugging presses it down and tape holds it.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 1.0 mm ledge from the rail to |X| 7.3, led in at 45 degrees; the window is the 0.45 mm the board actually bears on.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Far +X ledge, top 0.45 mm under the board plane, every layer under the board
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: As the near ledge; this one stands on the bed.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: 1.0 mm ledge from the rail to |X| 7.3, continuous to the bed.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Near +X V stop tab, every layer from its base to where the 45-degree face reaches |X| 8.5
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The USB-plug push drives the board corner arc into this face.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: A 1.1 mm tall tab from the rail with a 45-degree plan face tangent to the 0.3 mm-offset corner arc.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.feature: Far +X stop block on the bed, every layer
XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: The unplug pull drives the far corner arcs into these faces.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: A 1.1 mm tall block from the rail to |X| 7.3 standing on the bed.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.

Battery_Holder.feature: Cage lattice between the gate guides and the end plate, every layer
Battery_Holder.load_case: Cell weight, handling and rod loads pass through the chords, chevrons, spine and struts.
Battery_Holder.decision: 1.6 mm chords and bars at 45 degrees; the spine carries both rings.
Battery_Holder.note: Complete intervening-layer scan: every printed layer in the range, whole mesh section in the window and conservative inscribed bead footprints. Not a breaking force.
